title: As our guest pastor Logan Brown from New Zealand whispers jeremiah 29:11 to me and whispered some prophetic words. I felt the holy spirit and renewed my strength and hope. Thank you God for the renewed strength.
paragraphs: As our guest pastor Logan Brown  from New Zealand whispers jeremiah 29:11 to me and whispered some prophetic words. I felt the holy spirit and renewed my strength and hope. Thank you God for the renewed strength.
Jeremiah 29:11 "for i know the plans i have for you, declares the Lord, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and future.
